title: senecio leucanthemifolius subsp. vernalis
intro: Senecio leucanthemifolius subsp. vernalis, commonly known as the Autumn Senecio or Autumn Ragwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Senecio leucanthemifolius subsp. vernalis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have antioxidant and antispasmodic effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes due to potential toxicity from some of its constituents.
